boards.title: Your First Weekend at Saint Michael's College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence of campus stops that combines orientation, food, study, recreation, arts, and an alcohol-free residential program.

cards.title: Start with a campus bearings check
cards.subtitle: Hoehl Welcome Center · first stop
cards.notes: Use the welcome center as a clear arrival landmark, then follow the College’s campus directions to orient yourself before choosing the next stop.
cards.short_summary: A practical first landmark at the campus entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael's identifies the Hoehl Welcome Center at the north entrance and says visitor parking is available there.
cards.access_notes: Visitor parking is identified by the College; follow campus parking guidance.

cards.title: Find the Student Activities Office
cards.subtitle: Dion Family Student Center · plan the weekend
cards.notes: Stop by or check in with Student Activities to learn what is scheduled; the office plans orientation and campus events such as concerts, movies, and comedians.
cards.short_summary: A campus hub for getting connected to activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Activities Office is in Dion Family Center and plans Orientation plus campus events including concerts, movie nights, and comedians.
cards.source_title: Student Activities Office | Saint Michael's College
cards.access_notes: Check current programming with Student Activities before attending an event.

cards.title: Share a meal in Alliot Hall
cards.subtitle: Green Mountain Dining Room · midday reset
cards.notes: Meet a new classmate for a meal and use the dining room’s stations to choose what works for you; confirm current meal-plan or guest access first.
cards.short_summary: A sit-down meal stop in the main campus dining room.
cards.evidence_claim: The College describes the Green Mountain Dining Room in Alliot Hall and lists grill, vegetarian, sandwich, pizza, soup, salad, and dessert stations.
cards.source_title: Conferences and Special Events | Saint Michael's College
cards.access_notes: Dining access and payment depend on current College dining arrangements.

cards.entity_name: Chapel of Saint Michael the Archangel
cards.title: Take a quiet chapel pause
cards.subtitle: Chapel of Saint Michael the Archangel · early afternoon
cards.notes: Visit respectfully for a few quiet minutes or attend a scheduled service if that fits your weekend; check the current campus ministry calendar before going.
cards.short_summary: A central campus landmark for quiet reflection or worship.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael's says the Chapel of Saint Michael the Archangel is operated by the Society of Saint Edmund and that Mass is held daily.
cards.source_title: Conferences and Special Events | Saint Michael's College
cards.access_notes: Respect service times and confirm the current schedule with Campus Ministry.

cards.title: Settle into Durick Library
cards.subtitle: Durick Library · study and explore
cards.notes: Choose a quiet or group-study space, browse leisure reading on the main floor, or ask for research help while getting familiar with campus academic support.
cards.short_summary: A study stop with research help, leisure reading, and student services.
cards.evidence_claim: Durick Library provides quiet and group study spaces, public computers, leisure reading on its main floor, and research assistance.
cards.source_title: Durick Library | Saint Michael's College Catalog
cards.access_notes: The catalog says the library is open 87 hours weekly while classes are in session; verify daily hours before visiting.

cards.title: Move at Tarrant Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Tarrant Recreation Center · active break
cards.notes: Take an active break using an available recreation space, or look for an intramural activity that matches your interest and current skill level.
cards.short_summary: A recreation-center stop for an easy active reset.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael's says the Tarrant Recreation Center and Ross Sports Center include a fitness complex, indoor track, courts, pool, and fitness center.
cards.access_notes: Facilities are for the College community; check current recreation-center access and activity schedules.

cards.entity_name: Saint Michael's College Natural Area Nature Trail
cards.title: Walk the Natural Area trail
cards.subtitle: Saint Michael's College Natural Area · daylight outing
cards.notes: Use the trail map at a kiosk and keep to marked routes for a daylight walk; bring appropriate footwear and leave the natural area as you found it.
cards.short_summary: A campus nature walk with marked trail access.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael's established a 1.3-mile trail across its Natural Area, with trail kiosks and a posted trail map at each end.
cards.source_title: The Natural Area | Saint Michael's College
cards.access_notes: Go in daylight, stay on marked trails, and observe posted site guidance.

cards.title: Check McCarthy for a performance
cards.subtitle: McCarthy Arts Center · evening arts option
cards.notes: Look for a current recital, theatre, or arts event, then confirm tickets and arrival details before heading over; choose an event that fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: An evening option for a scheduled campus arts event.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael's identifies McCarthy Arts Center as a campus resource and says the building contains the Recital Hall, theater, and art gallery spaces.
cards.source_title: Honoring the past and looking ahead on McCarthy’s 50th Anniversary at St. Mike’s | Saint Michael's College
cards.access_notes: Programming and ticket requirements vary; verify the current event listing before attending.

cards.title: Join an alcohol-free residence-hall program
cards.subtitle: Residential Weekend Programming · Friday or Saturday evening
cards.notes: Check your floor or area announcements and join a scheduled program such as a movie night, floor dinner, barbecue, or food-themed activity with neighbors.
cards.short_summary: A residential way to meet people through scheduled alcohol-free activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael's says Residential Programs offers Friday and Saturday alcohol-free weekend activities, including floor dinners, barbecues, cupcake decorating, and movie nights.
cards.access_notes: Offerings vary by residence area; use current floor or area announcements for details.

cards.title: Save an outdoor program for Sunday
cards.subtitle: Adventure Sports Center · plan ahead
cards.notes: Browse the current outdoor calendar and choose a program suited to your experience; ask staff about expectations, instruction, gear, and registration before committing.
cards.short_summary: A planning stop for College-led outdoor opportunities.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael's Adventure Sports Center offers hiking, climbing, kayaking, skiing, current programming, and an outdoor events calendar.
cards.source_title: Adventure Sports Center | Saint Michael's College
cards.access_notes: Programs may require advance registration and may carry fees; consult the current calendar.
